title: Assistant Storage
subtitle: Choose where assistant workspaces live on disk

sections.locationHint: New assistant workspaces are created under the active root. Existing assistants keep working in their current location.

customRoot.label: Custom root directory
customRoot.description: Pick any directory on any drive. Leave empty to use the default location.
customRoot.manualHint: The desktop app can browse for a directory. In the browser-hosted Web UI, type an absolute path and select Apply.

activeRoot.label: Active root
activeRoot.description: New assistant workspaces are created here.

legacyRoot.label: Previous default root
legacyRoot.description: Existing assistants created before the custom root still live here and remain available.

existingAssistants.title: Existing assistants are not moved
existingAssistants.description: Assistants already created stay in their current location so their sessions and files remain reachable. Only new assistants use the new root.

picker.title: Choose the assistant workspace root directory

messages.loadFailed: Failed to load assistant workspace locations
messages.rootUpdated: Assistant workspace root updated. New assistants will be created under the chosen directory.
messages.rootReset: Assistant workspace root reset to the default location.
messages.saveFailed: Failed to update the assistant workspace root
messages.invalidPath: Enter an absolute path, for example D:\AssistantWorkspaces or /home/user/workspaces
messages.pickerUnavailable: The directory browser is only available in the desktop app. Type an absolute path instead.
